Hand-written fixtures that follow the structure documented by Meta for
WhatsApp Cloud API status webhooks:
https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/webhooks/reference/messages/status

All ids, numbers and timestamps are placeholders. They do not come from a
real account. Message ids match the simulator's `wamid.SIM.*` format so the
tests can correlate them with tracked messages.
